notes.manas-2010:p1438:b001:l006: Каканакта explicitly says in the womb although the surrounding news is of a birth; retained without chronological repair.
notes.manas-2010:p1438:b001:l018: Red sword of steel retained as printed; the extended image continues into the next line.
notes.manas-2010:p1438:b001:l019: Толто is the metal collar joining blade and handle in Yudakhin and the1969 explanatory dictionary: https://el-sozduk.kg/толто/. The unusual image is retained, not replaced by middle.
notes.manas-2010:p1438:b001:l020: Torrent-proof Chinese is an epic hyperbole; no geographical flood claim intended.
notes.manas-2010:p1438:b001:l027: Chalyar retained as an individual epic name. Edition glossary1834:l003–013 explains that the manaschi uses it among the Six Tigers, although its original sense is four friends/companions. https://el-sozduk.kg/чалыяр/.
notes.manas-2010:p1438:b001:l032: Horse as wing retained; printed кайрылба is second-person negative imperative, compressed here with the wing image. Precise idiomatic force remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1439:b001:l004: Jaw and tongue introduce Azhybay’s verbal prowess, not an anatomical diagnosis.
notes.manas-2010:p1439:b001:l012: Алача моюн, mottled neck, retained of the sabre; which part or decoration is meant is not established.
notes.manas-2010:p1439:b001:l019: Ай туяк is a horse sacrifice, explicitly attested in Yudakhin: https://el-sozduk.kg/tuyak-5/. No invented lunar ritual.
notes.manas-2010:p1439:b001:l029: Балтыр бешик means a cradle infant, not a walking child: https://el-sozduk.kg/балтыр/. No exact age added.
notes.manas-2010:p1439:b001:l030: Printed огой retained as Ogoy, not silently changed to Nogoy.
notes.manas-2010:p1439:b001:l032: Printed ток explicitly retained as fullness/satiation. Parallel following жок absence may suggest textual corruption, but no silent ток→жок repair has been made. Horse image remains difficult.
notes.manas-2010:p1439:b001:l035: Her head as banner and her female self made warrior preserve Kanykey’s assumption of leadership.
notes.manas-2010:p1439:b001:l041: Chalyar as at1438:l027; the text alternates touched/reached.
notes.manas-2010:p1440:b001:l009: Кыраң ridge follows Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кыра/. Costly ridges is awkward but visible; not silently emended to кыраан champions.
notes.manas-2010:p1440:b001:l019: Seven khans and the next line’s twelve khans both retained; no arithmetic reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p1440:b001:l022: Катын read contextually as кат-ын, his/her letter, in the report of entrusted correspondence; the spelling also permits woman. Kanykey’s entrusting is supplied from preceding context.
notes.manas-2010:p1440:b001:l034: Асый чыкма indicates reaching adult horse age; no unsupported exact age supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1440:b001:l037: Кара суу kept literally dark water; whether a named stream or hydrological spring-water term is intended is uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1441:b001:l003: Taybuurul retained beside the preceding Buurul variant without treating them as different horses.
notes.manas-2010:p1441:b001:l004: Бута бою is a bowshot/target-distance comparison. Arrowshot is approximate, not a measured distance.
notes.manas-2010:p1441:b001:l009: The visible command take your letter is retained despite the reported loss. No silent replacement of кат with horse, wife or compensation.
notes.manas-2010:p1441:b001:l018: Долу is a harsh epithet for the wife; shrew preserves the speaker’s disparagement.
notes.manas-2010:p1441:b001:l025: Printed Gabriel is retained, not corrected to Azrael. Жалаңкыч is death-taking angel in local glossary1837:l031.
notes.manas-2010:p1441:b001:l041: Умачтай көзүн ач- means open eyes wide/be wide awake: https://el-sozduk.kg/умач/. Their is supplied for the Chinese whom Manas means to subdue; Kyrgyz leaves the possessor implicit. This clause continues through1442:l001.
notes.manas-2010:p1442:b001:l005: Chalyar follows the edition’s individualized epic usage; see1438:l027.
notes.manas-2010:p1442:b001:l025: Seven khans and twelve Muslim khans both retained as source repetitions, not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1443:b001:l008: Twelve years retained; the text does not provide a reliable historical chronology.
notes.manas-2010:p1443:b001:l017: Салык is taxation in this explicit tribute passage, not the homonymous stored-goods sense.
notes.manas-2010:p1443:b001:l022: Cattle hair chopped and mixed into mud is literal construction detail; not generalized to straw.
notes.manas-2010:p1443:b001:l024: About six thousand champions and their forced labor retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1443:b001:l037: The pure white people follow bathing/conversion. Their exact grammatical gender is not explicit; the marriage context follows without adding consent.
notes.manas-2010:p1443:b001:l039: Printed ике understood as нике marriage in the fixed expression нике кый-. The initial loss is qualified, raw unchanged; Болбой retains insistence/coercion.
notes.manas-2010:p1443:b001:l040: Уска is нуска, example/model, in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/uska/. Rendered without claiming a modern legal institution.
notes.manas-2010:p1444:b001:l005: Уруктуу prolific/possessing lineage read with the ensuing indifference to forty years of slaughter; it is the narrator’s generalization.
notes.manas-2010:p1444:b001:l006: Ур III = нур light in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/ur-5/. Light-flooded land is a qualified contextual reading; ур II houri is another dictionary sense. Seed is not supported and is not used.
notes.manas-2010:p1444:b001:l022: Question about Töshtük’s burned reason retained as disparagement tied to his underworld descent.
notes.manas-2010:p1444:b001:l023: Тыргоот is rendered with established Torgut spelling, not a new people.
notes.manas-2010:p1444:b001:l025: One goat for three households retained exactly across the two lines.
notes.manas-2010:p1444:b001:l028: Азирет rendered Holy One; no definite identification with Ali imposed by this line alone.
notes.manas-2010:p1444:b001:l037: Жазгандын read as the one who writes fate. A possible disparaging epithet reading remains contextually less clear.
notes.manas-2010:p1445:b001:l020: Кысыр тай is a yearling still nursing because its dam is barren: https://el-sozduk.kg/эмди/ and https://el-sozduk.kg/sut-5/. Seven thousand, approximately, retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1445:b001:l029: Чаган spring festival in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/чага/. Every day is the source hyperbole, not a calendar correction.
notes.manas-2010:p1445:b001:l041: Була valuables/precious fabrics and furnishings, not simply cotton; Yudakhin exact plunder formula https://el-sozduk.kg/була/.
notes.manas-2010:p1446:b001:l004: Көксөө decrepit old person: https://el-sozduk.kg/koksoo-4/. Not the desire verb көксө-.
notes.manas-2010:p1446:b001:l018: Millet and wife comparisons are disparaging ethnic stereotypes spoken by the narrator; retained without endorsement.
notes.manas-2010:p1446:b001:l039: Шер animal-hero epithet; tigers is metaphorical, not additional characters.
notes.manas-2010:p1447:b001:l008: Contextually retranslated from the complete formula Ордолуу шайык көк жөкөр. Primary 1960 Semetey glossary PDF374 explicitly identifies it as an epithet of Kokand: great/holy/famous city and capital inhabited by many sheikhs. The complete formula, source image and adjacent Kyrgyz verses were individually reviewed; ordinary жөкөр dictionary footwear/retainer senses do not govern this geographic formula. Original raw text, IDs, coordinates and source lineation remain unchanged. Formula introduces Kokon/Margalang whose khans Kozubek and Malabek are named next; city epithet.
notes.manas-2010:p1447:b001:l031: Омбуткан remains morphologically uncertain. Harsh words is a qualified contextual rendering of the apology, supported only indirectly by Yudakhin омбу-домбу сүйлө- speak rudely/inappropriately: https://el-sozduk.kg/омбу/. No exact headword match claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p1447:b001:l036: Орусту explicitly Russians; retained despite the campaign’s Beijing setting.
notes.manas-2010:p1448:b001:l007: Кембайлап expresses forcing/driving; exact older formation remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1448:b001:l011: Өзүм жалгыз translated literally I am alone; an only-son exemption may be implied but is not inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1448:b001:l012: Threat to slaughter and eat the man is explicit and retained, not softened to punishment.
notes.manas-2010:p1448:b001:l030: Blood claim at Judgment retained; no assertion of a modern legal doctrine.
notes.manas-2010:p1448:b001:l041: Киндик кесип, кир төккөн is birthplace idiom with umbilical cutting/birth washing; the image is retained without literal household dirt.
notes.manas-2010:p1449:b001:l002: Ay Jangjung retained as the established personal designation; the rank component is not a separate new person.
notes.manas-2010:p1449:b001:l004: Кымбаттап valuing highly retained in the red-gold loading passage; syntax is compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p1449:b001:l011: Желбегей means worn loosely/draped, торко silk; no invented costume structure.
notes.manas-2010:p1449:b001:l022: Агача келин fair young woman: Yudakhin ага entry; not necessarily an older woman.
notes.manas-2010:p1449:b001:l024: Жактырбай read as not allowing fires to be kindled, linked with extinguishing; the alternative dislike sense is not chosen.
notes.manas-2010:p1449:b001:l034: Бадана mail armor retained in the women’s description; not silently converted to a beaded dress.
notes.manas-2010:p1450:b001:l032: Printed ар is valid Yudakhin ар II = нар I, camel: https://el-sozduk.kg/ар/. Direct HTML retrieval confirmed the entry. No dropped-н correction is needed. Thousand and red coat retained; no breed/hybrid claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1450:b001:l040: Даты өтүп, wearing away as by rust, is applied to the hero’s strength/lifespan; precise image remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1451:b001:l003: Көк жашык means extremely lean and weak;2015 dictionary quotes this exact line: https://el-sozduk.kg/kok-zhashyk-/. Not green or young flesh.
notes.manas-2010:p1451:b001:l010: Körögöch is treated as the male companion/seer, not a wife.1969 entry explicitly associates him with the Maamyts of Er Töshtük: https://el-sozduk.kg/korogoch-2/.
notes.manas-2010:p1451:b001:l024: Shuykuchu standardized with the next batch; living with Manas and secretly informing Kongurbay is explicit in the closing scene.
notes.manas-2010:p1451:b001:l031: Making the Chinese tremble like girls preserves the sexist comparison.
notes.manas-2010:p1451:b001:l034: Chubak’s rule of Sibe/Manchu retained despite the earlier attribution of Sibe rule to Muzburchak; no harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1451:b001:l035: Урунуш meeting/collision of mountains, paired with rivers joining; not literally constructing mountains.
notes.manas-2010:p1451:b001:l039: Бир сан remains one san, an epic multitude unit, without invented precise decimal count. Printed Тозуп retained contextually as spreading out; no silent replacement with тозот/тосуп.
notes.manas-2010:p1451:b001:l042: Казы-карта horse belly-fat and large intestine; май fat. Concrete foods retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1452:b001:l006: Шабыят is a wolves-and-sheep physical game, not chess. A named tradition-bearer account describes seated sheep and attacking wolves: https://kgcode.akipress.org/unews/un_post:14221?from=kgnews&place=newsbtm . Contextual English game description, no imported game rules added to verse.
notes.manas-2010:p1452:b001:l007: Forty foot/paces marking the game circle retained; its exact measurement and radius/diameter are not established.
notes.manas-2010:p1452:b001:l008: Ордо rendered knucklebone game; this is the traditional game, not a palace here.
notes.manas-2010:p1452:b001:l016: Printed Тыңчы read as scout/spy, coordinated with Serek and Syrgak. Not silently changed to тынчы peace.
notes.manas-2010:p1452:b001:l023: At forty remains literal, although Kyrgyl is called old; no invented age reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p1452:b001:l032: Conditional if the Chinese lament follows the printed кылса; the grammar is compressed but no unsupported demand is inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1452:b001:l039: Take a cap/cut off a head is the explicit overzealous-violence idiom, retained literally.
notes.manas-2010:p1453:b001:l007: Багалак ойно- wrestling/contending in Yudakhin бага entry. Abalak/ordo is an alternative dictionary sense (https://el-sozduk.kg/БАГАЛАК/); wrestling chosen with the following mounted-wrestling scene. Identification remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1453:b001:l016: Укурук кайрар man capable of resisting/protecting from an enemy, explicit Yudakhin and2015 phraseological dictionary: https://el-sozduk.kg/укурук/.
notes.manas-2010:p1453:b001:l024: Not mules but horses retained literally; the precise comparison remains obscure.
notes.manas-2010:p1453:b001:l025: Алым алган is literally tribute-taking; the relation to the newly subjected Chinese remains awkward and is not silently made tribute-paying.
notes.manas-2010:p1454:b001:l002: Таш rank-stone ornament on officials’ hats, not carried ammunition in this governors passage.
notes.manas-2010:p1454:b001:l010: Белдемчи a garment around the waist; skirted belts is descriptive, without assigning modern national costume.
notes.manas-2010:p1454:b001:l024: Узан- work at a craft in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/УЗ/. Metaphorical plying craft on people retained; no unsupported technical operation supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1454:b001:l031: Санат punishment/violent reprisal, Yudakhin sense I5 and1969 sense4: https://el-sozduk.kg/санат/. Not an instructional poem here.
notes.manas-2010:p1455:b001:l001: Кара көк fearless of a human, not a coat color: https://el-sozduk.kg/көк/.
notes.manas-2010:p1455:b001:l010: The lament’s first-person we and cooking/white fruit images are retained. The relation of speakers to the formerly exploited people remains ambiguous; no pronoun correction.
notes.manas-2010:p1455:b001:l039: Arm is visibly printed even though чарайна ordinarily protects the torso; no silent change to chest.
notes.manas-2010:p1455:b001:l042: Poison in preparation of the axe is explicit; no chemical details invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1456:b001:l014: Manas’s heat is a figurative dangerous presence; no literal temperature claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1456:b001:l019: Manzhuu is explicitly a man called Манжуу, distinguished typographically from the people rendered Manchu. No unnamed collective replaces the sorcerer.
notes.manas-2010:p1456:b001:l026: Aykhozho’s Bilerik and his presentation to Esenkan are explicit; this explains the sorcerer’s knowledge of Muslim practices.
notes.manas-2010:p1456:b001:l033: Эндей тон follows Yudakhin эндей чапан light lined robe without quilting: https://el-sozduk.kg/ЭНДЕЙ/.
notes.manas-2010:p1456:b001:l035: Дүңгө is a long homespun woolen sash in Yudakhin’s Tian-Shan sense3: https://el-sozduk.kg/дүң/. Not a grass root in this clothing context.
notes.manas-2010:p1456:b001:l039: Аса-муса holy mendicant’s staff retained as a functional description, not a new character named Musa.
notes.manas-2010:p1457:b001:l006: Wind unable to match donkey’s trot is the source hyperbole, retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1457:b001:l020: Акылга дыйкан figuratively rich in wisdom; the agricultural noun is not a literal occupation for Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p1457:b001:l025: Ашмачы cook, explicitly equated with ашпоз in2015 dictionary: https://el-sozduk.kg/ашпоз/.
notes.manas-2010:p1457:b001:l042: Syntactically unfinished at page boundary; the whipping of the donkey continues on1458. No completion from outside the assigned source is inserted.
